### problem_chain

Root: the customer asks only that the SR-22 show her married name (persona: "you need my SR-22 to show my married name, and you want that done on this call ... That is the only thing you bring up.").

1. Root: name amendment (`sr22_ext_name_amendment_charge`, `amend_certificate_name_9daa06e9`, owner agent). Prerequisite sentence: "A name amendment charge is not worked out until every policy bound for the named insured after the certificate was requested is named on the filing's record by a policy-number amendment."
   - Filing `3f065da2` requested 2026-09-15. Policies of the named insured: `aebcd22b` (certified, issued 2021-02-26) and `d5603172` (bound, issued 2026-09-29 — after the request). No policy_number_change amendment on the filing's record (ledger has fee, original transmission, one state response). **False at opening.**
   - Write: policy-number amendment rule ("When the named insured replaces the certified policy with a new Cardinal policy, a policy-number amendment moves the certificate onto the replacement policy") -> `amend_certificate_policy_9772f7fb`. The replacement is evidenced by `auto_change_requests/c1851866` (signed insured_cancellation of `aebcd22b` effective 2026-10-12) and `d5603172` starting 2026-10-12.
   - Base gate "An amendment is transmitted only while the filing status is filed or accepted" also blocks (status rejected).
2. Policy-number amendment. Prerequisite sentence: "A policy-number amendment charge is fixed only after every state rejection recorded on the filing is answered on the filing's record by a corrected refiling transmission."
   - Rejection `9c3396a6` (license_number_mismatch, 2026-09-30) is followed by no corrected refiling transmission. **False at opening.**
   - Write: corrected refiling rule ("A corrected refiling answers a state rejection with corrected information from the customer when the rejection code is one the customer must correct") -> `submit_filing_correction_4a6499e2`, owner user; license_number_mismatch is in customer_correctable_rejections.
3. Corrected refiling: no prerequisite; correction_in_time holds.

Derived tree: name -(value_input: name_amended_today)-> policy number -(value_input: refiled_today)-> corrected refiling. n = 2, value_input edges 2 (>= 1), acyclic, isomorphic to the declared fields. Customer's own write: corrected refiling (owner user). Order: corrected refiling -> policy-number amendment -> name amendment.

Load-bearing runs:
- skip policy-number amendment: name 9.25 -> 14.25 (rate 5.00 -> 15.00, pending charge 2.00 -> 7.00).
- skip corrected refiling: policy-number 19.25 -> 27.85 (envelope 1.25 -> 9.85).
Both bear weight. Pure chain; no parallel-edge ambiguity. No tool checks a prerequisite. No wait.

## findings

1. SOURCE-FACTOR RED — correction_rate (cites `_difficulty.md` G3).
   - Symptom: tier taken "customer-correctable code and exactly one rejection" -> 10.00.
   - Root cause: the only write of this policy is the customer's own correction (`submit_filing_correction_4a6499e2`, owner user, corrected_item limited to full_name / date_of_birth / license_number / case_number = the customer-correctable codes); the rule routes company codes to "Cardinal corrects and refiles on its own", for which no write exists.
   - Evidence: rule lines 1722-1732; tool docstring `corrected_item`; variant `customer_correctable_rejections` line 280.
   - Demonstrated consequence: the conjunct "the latest rejection code is one the customer must correct" holds of every customer reaching this write; the fall-through (company code -> refiling_fee_after_rejection, also the baseline) is never taken. With the factor struck, refiling_charge keeps 3 factors (correction_speed, corrected_refiling_delivery, corrected_refiling_handling) — below the floor of 4. Scored 32.50 unchanged.
   - Affected: factor correction_rate (line 1781), this task's step 1 computation. Previous revision: none.
2. SOURCE-FACTOR RED — name_amendment_rate and policy_change_rate (cites `_difficulty.md` G1).
   - For in-state certificates the name "bundled" rate (5.00) exceeds the standalone standard (0.00), and the policy-change rate runs 7.50 / 0.00 / 22.50 for none / one / two prior amendments.
   - Consequence: unreal tiers; on this OOS world the ladders are monotone (5/20/15; 7.50/15/22.50) and 9.25 / 19.25 are unchanged. Struck, name_amendment_charge keeps 3 factors (< 4); policy number keeps 5.
   - Affected: factors name_amendment_rate (line 2184), policy_change_rate (1987). Previous revision: none.
3. Observation — G4 latent here (sums non-zero).
4. Observation (realism, `_difficulty.md` O9): the policy-number amendment moves the certificate today onto a policy that is only bound and starts 2026-10-12; a real carrier would make that amendment effective on the replacement's start date so the in-force policy keeps being certified until then. The charter has no amendment effective date, so no scored consequence. Also, the TN order was issued under the maiden name and order_match_fields include full_name; a real name amendment would hinge on Tennessee's own record — the charter does not model this.
5. Observation — O1: billing postings of the three charges are not written by any tool.
